name: Fairmont Royal Palm Marrakech
insider_take: This palatial resort sits on 231 acres of lush gardens just minutes from the legendary Djemaa el-Fna square, where Atlas Mountain views frame one of Morocco's most luxurious retreats.
whats_special: The Fairmont Royal Palm boasts Morocco's largest spa at 2,500 square meters, features an 18-hole Robert Trent Jones Sr. golf course, and houses the country's most extensive wine cellar with over 25,000 bottles. The property's olive groves produce their own extra virgin olive oil served exclusively at the resort's restaurants.
pro_tip: Book a sunset horseback ride through the hotel's equestrian center - you'll gallop through olive groves with the snow-capped Atlas Mountains as your backdrop, an experience unavailable at any other luxury hotel in Marrakech.
dont_miss: The traditional hammam ritual at the So Spa, followed by mint tea on your private terrace overlooking the resort's 231-acre botanical paradise. The hotel's location offers the perfect balance - luxury resort tranquility with easy access to Marrakech's vibrant souks and historic medina just 15 minutes away.
pros: World-Class Golf & Wellness: Home to a championship 18-hole golf course and an expansive spa, offering an unrivaled resort-within-a-resort experience.
Stunning Atlas Mountain Views: Set on 231 acres of lush palm grove estate, guests enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the snow-capped Atlas Mountains.
Exceptional Dining: Multiple acclaimed restaurants and bars blend Moroccan culinary traditions with international flavors, including rooftop and poolside dining experiences.
Lavish Accommodations: Spacious rooms, suites, and private villas with traditional Moroccan architecture and modern luxury amenities, many featuring private pools or terraces.
Exclusive Perks via Accor HERA Program: WhataHotel! guests enjoy preferred rates, complimentary breakfast, early check-in/late check-out, and room upgrades when available.
cons: Secluded Location: Situated in the Palmeraie district, the resort is approximately 15–20 minutes from Marrakech's historic medina, requiring transportation for city exploration.
Premium Pricing: As one of Marrakech's most prestigious luxury resorts, nightly rates and on-site dining reflect a top-tier price point not suited for budget-conscious travelers.
